description: The one-at-a-time companion to WhatTheRack: ten buttons, each of which drops a single randomly picked module of that kind into the patch
notes: Each button picks one module at random from every installed plugin carrying its tag. VCO, LFO, VCA, SEQ, CLK, FX, VCF, ENV and MIX take their obvious kinds; WTF takes the utility group.
The WTF button's utility group covers modules tagged as clock modulators, sample and holds, recorders, slew limiters, switches and utilities.
The new module appears at the mouse pointer and pushes the existing patch aside to make room. It is added to the undo history, so one press of undo removes it.
The picking is done from the tags each maker set on their own modules, so what you get depends on which plugins you have installed. Anything tagged External is left out.
The ten question marks are drawn as plain buttons rather than as module parameters, so none of them can be clicked for help.
menu: Randomize Parameters — when this is on, every module a button spawns has its knobs randomized as it arrives; it comes up off
